topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: I understand the wish to have a bit more privacy, a clear boundary— ground rules for the shared space around us. Your neighbor’s idea to install a fence might seem a step towards solitude, but it’s also a chance to redefine how you both share the world. A gentle conversation, perhaps over a cup of coffee, could make this change a bridge instead of a wall. Listening to their reasons with an open heart can open doors to better understanding and mutual respect. After all, what we build around us often reflects what we keep within. A fence, then, could be more than just wood and nails; it could be a symbol of new beginnings, a thoughtful gesture of coexistence.
